about: Each case is one sentence a person says. 'role' is who says it (leader or developer). 'reaches' lists, for each example, where a memory from the sentence should end up: 'personal' is the speaker's own Personal space, 'team-shared' and 'leadership-shared' are the Shared spaces, and 'candidate' means the Approval example should propose it to Team Shared for approval. Any space not listed should receive nothing.

cases.sentence: We always run database migrations before deploying the API.
Payment webhook handlers must be idempotent so the same event ID never charges twice.
After the June 12 checkout outage, we learned never to deploy during peak traffic without a documented rollback plan.
Any change that touches the checkout funnel must ship behind a feature flag.
We approved a forty thousand dollar budget for the payments vendor migration next quarter.
We will hire two senior backend engineers for the checkout team in Q4.
Alice's mid-year performance review will focus on on-call ownership.
Leadership decided to pause the new marketplace pilot until after Black Friday.
Starting Monday, all production deploys require two reviewers.
Release freeze for checkout and payments begins Friday at 18:00 UTC and ends Monday morning.
I prefer a dark theme in my editor and keep the font size at 14.
I keep my personal notes in a private Obsidian vault on my laptop.
